mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 108.0 for two consecutive months during rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) indicates a supply shock that reduces corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 108.0 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index above 3.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% sustained for one month signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% for one month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls and unemployment rate above 3.8% indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE exceeds 3.8% for one month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction permits above 1250.0 thousand units for two consecutive months signal strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1250.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
